tool_input.description: Run a small program to observe the style's actual toString output

result:
Not a git repo, but I kept all exploratory scratch files confined to `_tools/out` and deleted them afterward — the only file created is the test class itself.

Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/builder/MultilineRecursiveToStringStyleAgentTest.java` (25 JUnit 5 test methods), self-contained in the same package so it can call the class's protected methods directly. It covers all primitive array overloads, `Object[]`, nested-array indentation, empty arrays, null handling, excluded types (String/boxed primitives/`Number` subclasses/`AtomicBoolean`), custom-object recursion with indent increase/decrease, `reflectionAppendArrayDetail`, a documented quirk where a `NullPointerException` on a null array leaks the indent state (no `finally`), instance independence, and integration checks via `ToStringBuilder`/`ReflectionToStringBuilder`. All tests pass via `./_tools/test.sh`.
